note: Same California commercial lease form as lease_001, differently filled. The getomni schema normalises the page into fourteen tidy values — ISO dates, numeric rent, party names and addresses — which discards the two hardest parts of a filled-in form: the term as actually written (a day number plus a 'Month Year' phrase in four separate blanks, not an ISO range), and the checkbox block. Extended with the document title, the premises state, the term blanks as written, the printed dollar figures alongside the handwritten ones, the instalment due day, the whole Options to Renew block including both checkbox states and the three blank renewal fields, and the form footer. All fourteen dataset values are preserved unchanged. Every added value corroborated by 8-14 of the 14 saved engine outputs. Judgement calls: (1) both renewal checkboxes are ticked on the page despite the 'Check one' heading; six engines emit two ticks and eight emit none at all, so recording both as true is the value that separates them. (2) The three renewal blanks (periods, years, months) are printed and empty and are recorded as null, to catch engines that fill them with plausible numbers. (3) The template repeats the 'day of ____' blank for both the commencement and the expiry and both copies carry the same value; each is recorded once. (4) The base-rent paragraph contains the same template glitch as lease_001 ('is required. payable monthly with the first payment due upon the' printed twice) and is not reproduced verbatim; only the instalment due day is extracted. (5) Fields added inside an existing dataset object are listed in field_provenance with dotted paths so the dataset/model split stays visible at sub-key level.

date.description: Date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

monthlyAmountPrinted.description: Monthly rent as pre-printed in parentheses, with currency symbol

securityDepositPrinted.description: Security deposit as pre-printed in parentheses, with currency symbol

instalmentDueDay.description: Day of the month each instalment falls due, as printed

endDate.description: End date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

startDate.description: Start date of the lease, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD

commencementDay.description: Day number written in the commencement blank

commencementMonthYear.description: Month and year written in the commencement blank

expirationDay.description: Day number written in the expiry blank

expirationMonthYear.description: Month and year written in the expiry blank

state.description: State named in the premises clause

optionsToRenew.description: Section 4 checkbox block, recorded exactly as ticked on the page

renewalNotAllowedChecked.description: State of the 'Lessee may not renew the Lease.' box

renewalAllowedChecked.description: State of the 'The Lessee may have the right to renew...' box

noticeDays.description: Minimum written notice before expiry, as printed
